Network Service Group Resource Get Network Service Group By ID
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/networkServiceGroups/:serviceGroupId

Gets the network service group information for the specified ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
serviceGroupId
int32
REQUIRED

The unique identifier for the network service group.

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
id
int32
name
string
services
object[]
description
string
